storyCards.headline: It's A Mistake: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Men At Work's "It's A Mistake" reached #6 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #6 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 15 weeks on the chart.

It's A Mistake was released in 1983.

Chart story — peaked at #6 on the Hot 100.
